provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Age of Innovation rulebook (Feuerland / Capstone, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Game board with the side for your player count up
steps.note: 3 players: the 3-5 side for first games, the 1-3 side for a challenge; 2 players have extra steps in The 2-Player Game

steps.text: 6 random Round Score tiles faceup on the spaces from 6 down to 1; box the rest
steps.note: The Palace/University tile can't sit on rounds 5-6; no Discipline may have all 3 of its tiles on rounds 1-5

steps.text: 1 random Final Round Score tile on top of the round 6 tile, covering its Science Bonus
steps.note: Redraw if it shows the same building as the round 6 tile

steps.text: Lay out the 7 Planning Display cards; a random Round Bonus tile and a random Faction tile by each
The other 3 Round Bonus tiles by the board with 1 Coin on each
Random Start player; from the player on their right, counterclockwise, each picks a set and takes the matching Planning display
Box the unchosen cards, displays and tiles
All buildings on their spaces; Palace Placeholder tile next to your Palace
Track markers on the bottom of the Sailing and Terraforming tracks
{n} Power tokens split between Bowls I and II as printed
7 Scholars and 3 Bridges nearby as your supply
Starting resources from the top-right corners of your Faction tile and Planning display
A Status marker on 0 of each Discipline track, then advance 1 per Discipline icon on your tile and display
Last Status marker on 20 of the Score track
Turn Order markers down the left column, Start player on top, then clockwise
In turn order each places 1 Workshop on their own terrain, then in reverse order a second
